# Contributing

Open an issue for a bug or a proposed feature. Include the commit, hardware model, expected/actual behavior and sanitized reproduction steps. Keep credentials, personal notes and device backups private.

Use a focused branch. Keep BSP and application boundaries clear and preserve the protected identity partition. Run `./tools/validate.sh` and any affected optional tests; state remaining device checks in your PR. Keep English/Chinese docs aligned and use Conventional Commits.

See [architecture](../docs/architecture.md), [build](../docs/build.md) and [agent instructions](../AGENTS.md). Contributions retain the license of the relevant program or asset.
